adbSqlFormatter.expressionWidth: Maximum width of a single line. Expression lists break at leading commas once the line is longer than this.
adbSqlFormatter.logicalOperatorNewline: Where to break the line for `and` / `or`.
adbSqlFormatter.linesBetweenQueries: Number of blank lines between statements.
adbSqlFormatter.requireSemicolonBetweenS: Check that every non-final statement ends with a semicolon when the file holds 2 or more statements (files with a single statement are not checked). The formatter never adds semicolons on its own.
adbSqlFormatter.missingSemicolonSeverity: Severity of the missing-semicolon hint: yellow squiggle (warning) or red (error).
adbSqlFormatter.formatOnSave: Format sql / mysql files on save — the single switch for it. While it is off nothing reformats your files on save (the extension also turns the editor's own editor.formatOnSave off for sql / mysql, since that is a separate path it cannot block at runtime). Manual formatting is never affected: Shift+Alt+F, the context menu, or the Command Palette.
adbSqlFormatter.takeOverSaveKey: Take over Ctrl+S / Cmd+S inside sql / mysql editors: format the document, then save it. Turn this off if another keymap should own that key (and use the command "Format and Save" or another binding instead).
